name: Sender
summary: Email and SMS marketing platform for small businesses and shops: newsletters, automation, landing pages, signup forms and popups and transactional email, with a generous free plan and paid tiers priced by list size.
best_for: small businesses, shops and creators with lists up to a few thousand subscribers who want newsletters, automation, forms and SMS at a low price, starting on a free plan that is generous on volume
skip_if: you need a long list of native integrations with niche tools, or deep CRM and sales pipeline features alongside your email, or you will not check the slider price for your real list size
honest_knock: The cheapest paid price only covers 500 subscribers, fewer than the 2,500 on the free plan, so the 8.01€ headline rises as soon as your list is larger; the page shows the step prices only on its slider. The 30% annual discount is for the first year and first-time users only. Prices exclude VAT. We could not read the refund terms: the terms-of-service link returned an error page on 13 October 2026. The support speed and customer figures on the pricing page are Sender's own claims. We have not used Sender ourselves.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-20; first read 2026-10-13 in a live browser on sender.net/pricing from a Netherlands connection, which shows euros, in both the annual and the monthly view with the FAQ opened; the US copy of the same page read the same night lists Standard at $108 a year, $75.60 the first year, and Professional at $180 a year, $126 the first year) Sender prices by the size of your list on a slider, and every figure here is for the lowest step. The Free Forever plan costs nothing, needs no card, never expires and covers up to 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 emails a month for one seat, with newsletters, automation, landing pages, signup forms and popups and transactional emails; your emails and forms carry Sender branding. Standard is 8.01€ a month on monthly billing for up to 500 subscribers and 6,000 emails a month, with 3 seats, no branding, SMS, unlimited templates and landing pages, A/B testing and ecommerce reports. Professional is 13.36€ a month for the same 500 subscribers and 12,000 emails, with 10 seats, a monthly SMS credit, advanced automation and reports, priority support and, on plans of 20,000 subscribers and up, a dedicated IP on request at no extra cost. Annual billing is the monthly price times twelve (96.18€ for Standard, 160.30€ for Professional), with 30% off the first year for first-time users: 67.32€ and 112.21€. Monthly email allowance on paid plans is 12 times your subscriber count on Standard and 24 times on Professional, with no daily sending limits. Enterprise is custom. A pay-as-you-go option sells credits without a subscription: 26€ for 5,000 emails. SMS is bought per message by destination country (0.107€ to the Netherlands on our reading of 20 October 2026). Prices exclude VAT. Every new account gets a 14-day Professional trial with no card, after which it falls back to Free.

compare_with.name: Moosend
compare_with.why: Moosend is in our dossiers too, re-verified on 9 October 2026: Pro from $7 a month billed yearly or $9 monthly for 500 contacts, rising with list size, with a 30-day free trial and no permanent free plan. Sender, re-read on 20 October 2026 in euros, has a Free Forever plan up to 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 emails a month, and Standard from 8.01€ a month at 500 subscribers, excluding VAT. The entry prices are close; the difference is that Sender lets a small list stay free indefinitely, while Moosend offers a trial and then charges. The currencies are not converted here.
